$note: Everything a user sees the product called, and the mark they see it under. Change it here and rebuild; nothing else holds a copy. This is NOT `mprelist`, the internal identifier frozen into com.mprelist, @mprelist/*, the Keycloak realm and the database — renaming that is a repo-wide refactor and a `down -v`. The name must never lead with 'Marktplaats' (Web Store policy on trademarks); it belongs in the tagline instead. `name` is provisional until T60 (#91) confirms Web Store name availability and a trademark search; domain availability it closed on 2026-09-19. **`domain` is now the domain** — T56 (#87) moved `adbump.nl`'s A record off its registrar and onto the VPS on 2026-09-23, and this line is the one edit that was waiting on it. It is `www.` rather than the apex on purpose: the apex is a permanent redirect to the site (infra/caddy/Caddyfile), so the address that serves `/privacy` is the one to write down. Its consumers are the two footer links on the sign-in page and the two in the mail the realm sends — and a sent mail is permanent, which is why this field had to become real before ADR-0035's mark could.
$icon: One square master, path relative to this file. Every size Chrome and the browsers ask for is resized from it at build time by packages/ui's `icon-png`, so no derivative of the artwork is written by hand and none can drift from it. **The test is drift, not whether a file is in git** (ADR-0033): apps/keycloak-theme/theme/ is a generated derivative that *is* committed, because the local stack bind-mounts it straight out of the working tree and so it has to exist without anybody running a build — and CI rebuilds it and fails on any difference, which makes it a cache of this file rather than a second copy of it. It reached the deployed host out of that host's own git checkout until T81 and now travels as image content (ADR-0034), which changed the delivery and not the rule. A hand-written stylesheet or a committed PNG still fails the rule, because nothing could hold either one to this file. 8-bit RGB or RGBA, non-interlaced, and never smaller than the largest size asked of it — the build refuses each of those by name rather than emitting a worse icon. 512px or more, so a size added later is still a downscale.
name: AdBump
tagline: Herplaats je Marktplaats-advertenties met één klik, zodat ze weer bovenaan staan.
